name: SAMRIDH – Startup Accelerators of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development & Growth
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
brief: SAMRIDH is a government program that supports startups by funding and accelerating innovative tech products so they can grow faster and succeed in the market.
briefFull: SAMRIDH is a government program that supports startups by funding and accelerating innovative tech products so they can grow faster and succeed in the market.
details:
The SAMRIDH – Startup Accelerators of MeitY for Product Innovation, Development & Growth programme, under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India, supports startups by providing funding, acceleration, and mentorship to help them develop innovative technology products, scale their businesses, and succeed in the market.
**OBJECTIVES**
• The SAMRIDH scheme supports existing and upcoming Accelerators to select and accelerate potential IT-based startups to scale.
• The programme focuses on accelerating the startup by providing customer connect, investor connect, and internationalisation connect services.
• The Scheme supports selected Accelerators for extending Accelerator services to startup and provide funding.
benefits:
• To startups: An investment of up to ₹40 lakh to the beneficiary startup(with an average of ₹30 lakh per startup per cohort). An equal matching private investment by the accelerator / investor of up to ₹40 lakh is disbursed to startups based on their current valuation and growth stage.
• To Accelerators: Accelerators develop customized acceleration programs to fit the needs of each startup in the cohort and provide services ranging from customer connect, investor connect, capacity enhancement, product enhancement etc. for which they are provided a budget of ₹2 lakh per startup to a maximum of ₹20 lakh per cohort.
eligibility:
• Accelerators – registered as Section 8 company under Companies Act 2013 or as Society under Societies Registration Act (not-for-profit).
• IT-based startups.
howToApply:
[Online]
Step 1: Visit the official MeitY Startup Hub website: [MeitY Startup Hub](https://msh.meity.gov.in/)
Step 2: Click on Startups and select [Register](https://msh.meity.gov.in/register) to create a new account.
Step 3: Enter the required details such as First Name, Last Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Password, and Confirm Password.
Step 4: Click Register to create your MSH account.
Step 5: After successful registration, go to the Login page. MSH Login
Step 6: Enter your registered Email ID and Password and click Login.
Step 7: After login, access the Startup section and complete/update your startup profile with the required information.
Step 8: Check the available schemes, programmes, or startup opportunities and select the relevant one.
Step 9: Fill in the required application details and upload the documents requested for the selected programme.
Step 10: Review the information and submit the application. Keep the application/reference details for future use.
documentsRequired:
1. Certificate of Incorporation/Registration
1. DPIIT Startup Recognition Certificate (if applicable)
1. Detailed Business Plan/Project Proposal
1. Pitch Deck/Startup Profile
1. Financial Details and Funding Requirements

faqs.a: SAMRIDH is a MeitY programme that supports IT-based startups through acceleration, funding, mentorship, and market connections.

faqs.q: What is the main objective of SAMRIDH?
faqs.a: To help technology startups grow, scale their products, and succeed in domestic and international markets.
IT-based startups and eligible accelerators can benefit from the scheme.

faqs.q: Who can apply as an Accelerator?
faqs.a: Eligible not-for-profit organisations registered as a Section 8 company or society can apply.

faqs.q: What support is provided to startups?
faqs.a: Startups receive acceleration support, customer connect, investor connect, internationalisation support, and funding.

faqs.q: What is the maximum investment available to a startup?
faqs.a: A beneficiary startup can receive investment support of up to ₹40 lakh.
Yes. An equal matching private investment of up to ₹40 lakh may be provided by the accelerator/investor.

faqs.q: What is the average investment per startup?
faqs.a: The average investment is around ₹30 lakh per startup per cohort.

faqs.q: What support is provided to Accelerators?
faqs.a: Accelerators receive support to design and provide customised acceleration programmes and startup services.

faqs.q: What is the budget available to Accelerators?
faqs.a: Accelerators can receive ₹2 lakh per startup, up to ₹20 lakh per cohort, for providing accelerator services.

faqs.q: What type of startups are targeted?
faqs.a: The scheme primarily targets IT-based and technology-focused startups with potential for growth and scale.
